title: feedwarden — daily Merchant Center suspension watch for Shopify stores
oneLiner: For Shopify store owners and the freelancers who run their stores, it checks the store's trust signals daily and emails a plain-English alert when something Google's Misrepresentation checks look at breaks, instead of after the account is suspended.
overlaps: none in David's portfolio; market competitors are GMC Scout, GMC.APPS and AdNabu
